source_notes.TSBench: Repartition native supervised train+validation by whole exact/near request family70/15/5/10. Native trajectory-eval files lack injection/malicious labels and are not relabeled or substituted into these core tasks.
source_notes.routing: Fixed11-model pool; both shot regimes and both objectives. Query families shared across views/objectives. Profiles fitted only from the FINAL retained training rows after duplicate/role resolution; no task names, gold answers or per-input future outcomes enter model inputs.

overlap_audit.policy: Native whole-family roles with test > calibration > validation > train; MAUD explicitly repartitioned by contract; near/exact context duplicates removed across folds. Near retrieval64-permutation MinHash, exact three-word Jaccard>=.85; approximate audit cannot prove semantic independence.

data_selection: Metadata/labels for one-time stratification and support audit only; no model predictions used.
historical_exposure: Some native benchmark core-test examples were evaluated by earlier models. They are excluded from this cycle training/selection, but are not claimed never inspected by the project.
transfer_status: Separately constructed evaluation-only source/task transfer suite; never pooled into core scores.
limitations: TATQA/LEDGAR do not release original-report/document identifiers for all contexts; group on released context/request IDs plus exact/near content.
BANKING77/LEDGAR use full native77/100 labels; MAUD uses declared eligible native review questions with complete task-specific ontologies.
MAUD source folds overlap contracts; explicit document repartition replaces them.
Native/public labels and programmatically checked counterfactuals are not independent production financial-workflow adjudication.
Routing is historical released11-model outcomes, not current production routing.

training_context_exclusion.policy: Same training rows for both models; exclude whole source families if any selected training view exceeds either tokenizer envelope. All validation/calibration/test inputs remain requested, without truncation.

overlap_audit.method: exact normalized + 64-permutation MinHash retrieval at .75 / exact three-word Jaccard >= .85; bidirectional exact word-boundary containment >=8 words and40 chars; source-family propagation
overlap_audit.limit: Approximate retrieval is not exhaustive semantic deduplication; public pretraining exposure unknown.

transfer_test.policy: Separate source/task-transfer reporting. Exclude source families touching any core split by exact/near/long containment audit. No transfer cases are used in training, checkpoint selection or calibration.
transfer_test.historical_exposure: These published transfer sources/cases were evaluated by earlier models; they are evaluation-only for phase4, not claimed never inspected during the project.

model_capacity_note: 128 answer-code capacity; actual core tasks use2..100 candidates, including full native77/100-way BANKING77/LEDGAR.
